title: QuestionDefinition
description: A single training question. Fields that reveal the answer (symbol, startTime, endTime, future, answer) must not be shown to the user before they submit their call.

id.description: Stable opaque hash. Does not contain the symbol or dates.

horizon.description: Number of future bars the user is predicting.

symbol.description: Reveal-only: must not be shown before the user answers.

startTime.description: Unix UTC seconds of the first setup bar. Reveal-only.

endTime.description: Unix UTC seconds of the last future bar. Reveal-only.

setup.description: Bars shown to the user during the question. No timestamps.

future.description: Reveal-only: bars animated after the user answers. Must not be accessed before given is recorded.
